Creature click reactions, before and after

These are the game captured, not a mock: each creature's deep-react-* scene clicked and stepped at 60 fps, a frame taken every third frame, on main (before) and on feat/creature-polish (after), cropped alike. The players run them at their real speed; slow shows each frame four times as long. The number by each side is the most the creature moved in one 60 fps frame, in cells, its own swim included. The strip under each is every second captured frame (0.1 s apart).
